mapper.select: SELECT user_id, residence_city, housing_type, home_size_level, has_children, has_other_pets, allergy, max_shedding_level, daily_companionship_hours, work_schedule, budget_level, experience_level, personality_preference, accept_special_care, create_time, update_time FROM user_adoption_profile WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_adoption_profile( user_id, residence_city, housing_type, home_size_level, has_children, has_other_pets, allergy, max_shedding_level, daily_companionship_hours, work_schedule, budget_level, experience_level, personality_preference, accept_special_care, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{residenceCity}, #{housingType}, #{homeSizeLevel}, #{hasChildren}, #{hasOtherPets}, #{allergy}, #{maxSheddingLevel}, #{dailyCompanionshipHours}, #{workSchedule}, #{budgetLevel}, #{experienceLevel}, #{personalityPreference}, #{acceptSpecialCare}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE residence_city = VALUES(residence_city), housing_type = VALUES(housing_type), home_size_level = VALUES(home_size_level), has_children = VALUES(has_children), has_other_pets = VALUES(has_other_pets), allergy = VALUES(allergy), max_shedding_level = VALUES(max_shedding_level), daily_companionship_hours = VALUES(daily_companionship_hours), work_schedule = VALUES(work_schedule), budget_level = VALUES(budget_level), experience_level = VALUES(experience_level), personality_preference = VALUES(personality_preference), accept_special_care = VALUES(accept_special_care), update_time = NOW()
